message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout, and I was feeling pretty smug with my stash of flashlights and power banks. I ended up lighting up the whole living room like a cozy campout, while my neighbors were still fumbling around in the dark. It reminded me that being gloriously over-prepared can turn an inconvenience into a fun little adventure. What’s your go-to blackout gear that makes you feel like a preparedness pro?
